title: Ubugingo bw'agaciro bwabajije ubutegetsi
intro: Mu nkuru za Korowani, habayeho umuntu ufite ubutunzi n'ubumenyi byabaye inkuru y'impimbano. Uyu muntu yavuye ku isi afite imitako n'ubutunzi byatangaje abamurebaga, nyamara imitima yabo yaratangiye kwishyira hejuru kubera ubwibone. Twifatanye natwe mu gusesengura ibanga ry'imwe mu nkuru za Korowani zigaragaza ko ari yo yibutsa abantu, aho ubwiza bw'ibintu buhura n'iherezo ryoroheje munsi y'ubutaka bwababyaye.
clues: Navuye mu butaka nijimye imitako yakuruye amaso ya buri wese.
Nari mfite ubutunzi bwinshi n'ubumenyi bwimbitse byantandukanyaga n'abandi.
Ubwo intumwa yazaga ihamagara abantu ku Mana, nabajije ku butegetsi bwabo n'ishema.
Abari hafi yanjye bansubije ko ineza ya Allah atari yo soko y'ubutunzi bwanjye.
Abantu banjye batangajwe n'icyubahiro cyanjye kandi bifuriza iherezo nk'iryanjye.
Inyubako zanjye nziza cyane zamizwe zose mu butaka nk'igihano cy'Imana.

arabic: وَقَـٰرُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَـٰمَـٰنَ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ سَـٰبِقِينَ
verse: And [We destroyed] Qārūn and Pharaoh and Hāmān. And Moses had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrunners [of Our punishment]. (29:39)
